rdfs:label: altLabel
rdfs:comment: An alternative lexical label for a SKOS Concept — a synonym, abbreviation, or other equivalent name.
notes: Use for synonyms, abbreviations, acronyms, and variant spellings meant to be displayed; put misspellings and other non-display search strings in `urn:solid:hiddenLabel`. Repeat for multiple alternates. By SKOS rule, `prefLabel`, `altLabel`, and `hiddenLabel` values for the same Concept must be pairwise disjoint within a language. Upstream SKOS declares no domain: usable on any resource (Concept, ConceptScheme, Collection).

history.note: Misspellings now directed to hiddenLabel; added hiddenLabel to notToBeConfusedWith; dropped rdfs:domain (none upstream).
